verdict.rationale: The IRS documents an XML-based system-to-system machine channel (MeF) and an IRIS A2A intake, which implies a structured XML specification. The pack never shows that XML schemas, an OpenAPI spec, or a data dictionary are actually published, and probes of OpenAPI paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of published MeF/IRIS XML schemas (XSDs) or business rules, a data dictionary, any OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of schema availability.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary

citations.quote: MeF uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format.
